out_of_scope_observations.observation: saveMutations fires fetch(/api/save) without keepalive:true and without a local pending-save outbox. If the user reloads in the 50-200ms between drop and HTTP commit, the next page hydration may serve old disk state (codex round-2 finding, classified out_of_scope for this cycle). The user-stated AC3 reload survival test (wait for autosave debounce, then reload) is satisfied; the reload-too-fast race is a separate UX concern.

_get_or_create_slot does day[slots].setdefault(slot_id, ...) with NO schema-allow-list validation. Front-end SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS guard is load-bearing today; server-side defense-in-depth would be more robust.
